method: A STATIC_ONLY original dispatch table and queue arithmetic

annotation_prerequisites.limits: Retained bytes/annotation consistency only; not native effects, initialization, natural reachability or semantic acceptance

facts.input: Entry RDX -> nonvolatile RDI; earlier helper effects and valid ABI/stability explicitly conditional.
facts.formula: D = (low32(incoming row pointer) - low32(20E600(context+C) return)) mod 2^32. S = u16(second context load+8). With S>0, q=floor(D/S), w=q&0xFFFF. w==FFFF -> queue DWORDFFFFFFFF; otherwise queue DWORD=w-208 mod2^32.
facts.context: Two independent loads of QWORD2EBF138 at306898/3068AB; first supplies lookup key DWORD+C, second supplies divisor WORD+8. Do not assume identical contexts or immutable descriptor/lookup.
facts.divisor: No zero-divisor guard between WORD load and DIV ECX; S>0 is a precondition, not an observed initialized invariant or fault.
facts.scope: Examples are arithmetic consequences under coherent row/base/stride premises, not original-code executions. Kind4 alone does not locally check row ID; any exclusion requires the relationship between global kind and this call's row pointer.
facts.limits: No natural kind4/candidate pair, caller/owner coherence, setter/dispatch scheduling, initialized descriptors, native helper effects, lifetime/reuse or whole OV42 closure. Normal Win64 ABI, readable disjoint state and no interference required. Entry earlier helper calls can affect state; no side-effect-free whole-function claim.
